Method of Attack: Distributed through MALSPAM campaigns utilizing malicious documents and macros to download and install ransomware
Emails pretending to be invoices with malicious PDF attachments that prompt to open embedded Word documents with macros
Macros execute to download and run ransomware that encrypts targeted file types using AES encryption and appends .wlu extension
Impacted Systems: Windows systems with targeted file types for encryption
Attack Vector: Malicious email attachments (PDFs) with embedded Word documents containing macros
User enabling macros to execute ransomware download and execution
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom note titled 'JAFF DECRYPTOR' with instructions to install Tor Browser and visit http://rktazuzi7hbln7sy.onion/
